svg.text: THE AUDIO NEVER ENTERS THE ESP32

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tuner's analogue output goes to the mux, not to the chip,

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so nothing is resampled and nothing is re-encoded — the radio

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sounds like a radio rather than like a codec.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The deck draws the screen. It is not in the signal path.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ Never run on hardware. This is the intended wiring, drawn from the firmware's pin map — not a photograph of a working deck.
